sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Primary central nervous system lymphoma》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a diffuse large B cell lymphoma in which the brain, spinal cord, leptomeninges and/or eyes are exclusive sites of disease.

evidence.text: Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a diffuse large B cell lymphoma in which the brain, spinal cord, leptomeninges and/or eyes are exclusive sites of disease.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Primary central nervous system lymphoma》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Standard of care includes methotrexate-based polychemotherapy followed by age-tailored thiotepa-based conditioned autologous stem cell transplantation and, in patients unsuitable for such treatment, consolidation with whole-brain radiotherapy or single-drug maintenance.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Personalized treatment, primary radiotherapy and only supportive care should be considered in unfit, frail patients.

evidence.text: Standard of care includes methotrexate-based polychemotherapy followed by age-tailored thiotepa-based conditioned autologous stem cell transplantation and, in patients unsuitable for such treatment, consolidation with whole-brain radiotherapy or single-drug maintenance.
Personalized treatment, primary radiotherapy and only supportive care should be considered in unfit, frail patients.
